evidence_basis.summary: Buyer messages recur and current audit found no durable triage loop.

purpose.summary: Prevent qualified inquiries from being lost.
purpose.desired_outcome: Every new inquiry reaches a qualified next action within the accepted response window.
purpose.leverage_hypothesis: Reduce owner inbox triage and response latency.

template_matches.reason: The observed trigger, classification, deduplication and next-action pattern matches inquiry triage.

current_state.current_burden: Manual inbox review and owner routing.

escalation_conditions: requested action exceeds standing communication grant

readiness.evidence_requirement: message classification + contact-history receipt + next-action receipt
readiness.accepted_outcome_requirement: qualified inquiry has an accepted routed next action
